headings.text: An open-source CMS for Next.js. Content described in TypeScript, a calm admin for editors, all on your own Postgres.
Add a field and every query, form and response knows about it. No codegen, no client to configure.
One package, one config file and two routes. There’s no service to sign up for and no second server to run.
Needs Next.js 16 and React 19. Then open your app’s admin page and create the first account.
